levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Items are folded or hung without following the taught sequence, resulting in loose, uneven folds or hangers facing mixed directions.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Fold-type items follow the sleeves-in, half, half-again sequence, and hung items are closed and face the same direction, with adult confirmation.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner corrects their own technique mid-task after noticing an uneven fold or crooked hanger without being told.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Folded or hung items are left out or placed in the wrong drawer or closet section.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All folded and hung items are placed in their correct drawer or closet spot, confirmed by the adult.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All items are placed correctly, and the learner explains the specific reason a particular item belongs in its spot.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The learner climbs on furniture or forces a stuck drawer instead of asking the trusted adult for help.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The learner stays off furniture for high reaches and asks the trusted adult for help when needed.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner names the reach or drawer issue out loud before it becomes a problem.

lookFors: The adult confirmation specifically checks both the fold-type items and the hung items, not just one group.
The reflection response names one specific tricky item and the specific fix, not a general 'it went fine' statement.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
